name: NIWA PostGIS spatial databases (2006)
description: NIWA's documented use of open-source PostGIS for operational scientific geospatial data in 2006.
story: On 30 October 2006 NIWA's Brent Wood described using PostGIS on several research systems, including spatial datasets with hundreds of millions of features. His archived technical correspondence demonstrates that open-source spatial database management was part of routine research practice well before the later growth of hosted web-mapping services.

Wood's example records operational use rather than a software procurement announcement. The underlying scientific datasets were multiple and are not identified by the mailing-list exchange, so they should not be assigned invented dataset names or applications.
